scope: Local release candidates. Registry and GitHub publication are recorded separately. Desktop uses isolated synthetic sessions and real files. No model calls or modifications to user history.

previewPackage.name: filens-preview
checks: Standalone installation without runtime dependencies
MIT license and third-party notices
TypeScript consumer imports of split and all-in-one exports
64 real browser previews from installed assets
No external runtime requests
Single JavaScript runtime request for all-in-one
CLI loopback HTTP restrictions
Native WAV audio, HEIF decoding and native MOV playback or explicit codec errors without FFmpeg
12 PDF/iWork/RAW/STEP/HEIF/RAR previews after Vite production bundling of npm exports

interactions: loading identifies the file and respects reduced motion
closing and reopening PDF releases each worker, reuses exact first-page pixels and skips repeated page decoding
cached Numbers restores its archive for lazy sheets, preserves sheet content and releases workers
all 16 format paths retain working zoom and fullscreen; PPTX omits page/fit/rotation controls and keeps keyboard slide navigation
document fullscreen opens from the keyboard, contains controls and restores them to the header on exit
live DSH language and theme changes preserve the document and current page
3D canvas fills the pane without a toolbar and supports direct orbit/zoom
double-click restores the complete 3D model after orbit and zoom
compact model inspector preserves the canvas; zoom, fullscreen, keyboard tabs, search and section controls work in a narrow dark pane
3D auto framing keeps the whole model visible in a tall narrow pane
Word pages fit narrow/resized panes, visibly zoom and support fullscreen through the common controls
resizing the Word pane preserves the reading position
late events from a previous document are ignored
localized parser failure exposes details and a working retry action
encrypted documents expose the password form and render after password entry
short panes do not inherit a fixed minimum height
concurrent tabs share runtime assets but keep controls and lifecycle independent

dshDesktop.scope: Installed DSH Desktop; synthetic 270-turn and one-turn sessions; real local documents; no model calls or user history edits
checks: Group cards show shortened session titles with the full title on hover, and real Office thumbnails
Group thumbnails fill the cover; two files use both halves and short titles use a compact caption
Collapsed sessions align with file grid columns and preview at most four representative files
Temporary session files are hidden by default and can be revealed; ordinary documents in the OS temporary directory remain visible
Session groups start folded; expand, collapse and session filtering retain the correct files
All history pages collected; shared paths deduplicate, different directories stay separate
Confirmed missing references are excluded before cards, session counts and related-file recommendations are built
Existing corrupt and source-code files retain type covers; only confirmed absence is hidden
Stored generic attachment resolves through the native provider and previews real PDF bytes
Related files explain their reference relationship, open with keyboard or mouse, and retain source messages
Same file retains four exact source occurrences across two sessions
The reader file sidebar is at most 160 pixels wide
Photos-style details keep the filename fixed, show actual byte size, follow theme and close with Escape without reopening the preview
Source navigation loads the oldest history and scrolls to its stable message identity
An answer file switches from Trajectory to Chat and locates its corresponding question
100% fits completely in the real sidebar and workspace toolbars
Workspace plugin has the native localized title 文件工作台 and a package icon
Native plugin manager disables and enables File workspace independently of sidebar Preview
Workspace attachment preview remains functional while sidebar Preview is disabled
100% also fits at a 600-pixel Desktop window width
Narrow-window details become an inset bottom sheet and dismiss without leaving the document
Group cards fit a narrow window in both grid and list modes
Word, PowerPoint and Excel show real rendered thumbnails rather than fallback covers
A file deleted after scanning disappears when opened, including navigation and related-file lists
Refreshing rechecks existence and restores a file recreated at the same path

limitations: Linux and Windows executables are cross-built; native execution was not retested.
Mobile ZIPs contain source SDKs with offline assets; physical iOS/Android devices were not retested.
WebKit iWork previews retain their documented file:// worker restriction and pass local HTTP compatibility checks.
